summary: A staff-run, drop-in LEGO building program hosted biweekly at the East Asheville branch of the Buncombe County Public Library. It is open to all ages with library-supplied bricks and no membership, sign-up, or dues; attendees are a rotating public rather than a fixed set of returning members.

evidence.note: Description says 'Have fun building a unique creation with LEGOs at the East Asheville Public Library... Please leave your personal Legos at home because we've got plenty' and 'This program is open to all ages' with no membership or sign-up language.

Second listing is identically worded, organizer is listed as East Asheville Library, tags include 'Library Program' and 'Beginner Friendly' consistent with a drop-in library activity rather than a persistent membership group.
Bilingual (English/Spanish) title and framing match standard public-library outreach programming rather than a self-organized club with a fixed roster.

Attempted to fetch the Buncombe County Public Libraries events page for corroborating detail; the page returned a 404, so no additional confirmation was available beyond the event listings themselves.
